jobs.title: Backend Developer (Python – FastAPI / Flask / Django)
jobs.description:
Location: Remote

Experience: 1–3 Years

We’re looking for a Python Backend Developer to build secure, scalable APIs and services using FastAPI, Flask, or Django. You’ll work with product, frontend, and DevOps to ship reliable features, manage databases, and keep performance tight in production.

Responsibilities

Design, build, and maintain RESTful (and optional GraphQL) APIs with FastAPI/Flask/Django.



Model data and write efficient queries using PostgreSQL/MySQL (ORMs: SQLAlchemy / Django ORM).



Implement auth (OAuth2/JWT), RBAC, input validation (Pydantic/DRF serializers), and security best practices.



Write clean, testable code with pytest/unittest, plus unit/integration tests and API contracts.



Own migrations (Alembic/Django migrations), indexing, and query optimization.



Add caching (Redis) and background jobs (Celery/RQ) for performance and reliability.



Collaborate on API contracts with frontend/mobile; document with OpenAPI/Swagger.



Set up and maintain CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions/GitLab CI/Jenkins) for build, test, and deploy.



Deploy/operate services on AWS/GCP/Azure using Docker (Kubernetes a plus); monitor with Sentry/Prometheus/Grafana/ELK.



Troubleshoot production issues; track performance with APM and logs.



Requirements

1–3 years of hands-on backend development in Python.



Strong in FastAPI/Flask/Django and Python 3.10+ features (typing/asyncio).



Solid database skills: PostgreSQL and/or MySQL (schema design, joins, transactions, indexing).



Experience with ORMs (SQLAlchemy/Django ORM), migrations (Alembic/Django), and query optimization.



Knowledge of API design, error handling, pagination, rate limiting, and OpenAPI docs.



Familiarity with Docker, basic cloud deployment (AWS/GCP/Azure), and CI/CD.



Version control with Git; good debugging and performance tuning skills.



Bachelor’s in CS/Engineering or equivalent practical experience.



Clear communication in English.



Nice to Have

Django REST Framework (DRF) or FastAPI + Pydantic deep dive experience.



Celery/RQ, Redis, WebSockets, GraphQL (Ariadne/Strawberry).



Kubernetes/Terraform, serverless (AWS Lambda/Cloud Functions).



Security: OWASP Top 10, secrets management, compliance awareness.



Observability: Sentry, Prometheus/Grafana, ELK, Datadog.

Position:  Python Mid Senior Engineer Django REST FastAPI at awesome SaaS
Compensation: $90,000 – $160,000
Location: Remote
Accolades: Best in Biz Silver Award – Fastest Growing Company in USA (under 99 employees)
Web: www.LeadSherpa.com
Who is Lead Sherpa?



Company Core Values: Respect, Integrity, Drive, Innovation
Our MISSION is to empower real estate professionals and help guide them to success. Our VISION is to create the most powerful lead and data management technology suite in the real estate industry, and we are well on our way.
Lead Sherpa’s office is located in Denver, Colorado, however, we are also a fully remote team strategically positioned across the Western Hemisphere and operating with a high level of autonomy and trust. Our focus is on creating a dynamic, positive, and supportive work environment where our team members can grow and thrive.
Schedules are flexible as long as deadlines are hit. Our team takes full ownership of every project—not only do they work well independently without supervision, but they also work well within the team ecosystem. Our company culture cultivates a feeling of camaraderie and a sense of belonging and direction. Every team member knows exactly what our targets are, where we are going, and how we will get there.
Team members enjoy company-sponsored health care, a flexible time-off policy, and are eligible for a 401(k) retirement plan with generous company matching contributions. We take ownership of our roles and we are treated with respect, creating an ideal work environment for everyone to thrive. The team is always supported with the necessary resources and training to accomplish their goals and grow professionally.
We are always searching for more A-Players to join our team. If Lead Sherpa sounds like the place for you to put your drive and skills to good use, please let us know.
Position Details:  Back-end Developer
Responsibilities:
Lead Sherpa is looking for mid-and senior-level engineers to join our engineering team with specific experience in Django, REST Framework, and other python-based web frameworks implementing industry best practices. Experience with analogous technologies (e.g. MVC . NET, Spring, Rails) will be considered as long as command of python and web principles are strong. New services are being built as microservices and using newer frameworks like FastAPI and dataclasses, as well as potentially Golang for higher performance applications. Data normalization across synchronous and asynchronous systems is essential, with JSON Schema, OpenAPI, and related technologies being leveraged to that end. Experience with containers is essential, and experience with container orchestration is preferred.

Maintain current project standards and offer suggestions for future improvement.
Build out new features using our existing stack as well as emerging technologies.
Strong focus on building out well-documented, tested, resilient code to improve agility/stability of our products
Be a good communicator and express your concerns or need for elaboration on requirements

Requirements:

3+ years of experience working with Django and Django REST Framework
3+ years of experience working with RESTful APIs
3+ years of working with Celery, Prefect, or other task management tools
1+ years of experience implementing asynchronous systems using WebSockets and other message queuing and/or pub/sub-technologies
1+ years of experience building 12-factor applications, container images, and orchestrating a stack in both development and deployment environments
PostgreSQL, Elasticsearch, Redis, and RabbitMQ experience preferred
Strong preference for and experience with object-oriented programming
Believer in DRY principles
Experience with auto-generated documentation
Experience with building an oauth2 service for outside applications
Comfortable working with many 3rd party services
A strong desire for continuous improvement and taking great pride in what you build
Attention to detail and desire to build out clean and beautiful code that future developers will enjoy

Benefits:
US Team Members

Company-sponsored health insurance, vision, and dental
401(k) with company match

International Team Members

Company contribution to health insurance expenses, as needed

All Team Members

Fully remote and flexible schedule
Flexible and generous PTO policy
$2,000 home office/hardware gift – equipment is yours to keep!
Individualized paid coaching/growth training
